title: The release that was live but marked failed.
description: A release that passed deploy but failed its smoke checks still served traffic. How shipper recorded it, why rollback picked the wrong target, and the two fixes.
lede: A deploy can finish and still fail a check afterwards. In that gap, shipper’s record said one thing and production said another. Two fixes, on 20 and 23 November, closed it.
summary: A release that failed its smoke checks was still serving traffic, but shipper recorded it as not live. We fixed what rollback and the stale check believed, in two steps.
